info.title: HawkerHub API
info.description: RESTful API for the HawkerHub Singapore Hawker Centre Management System. Protected endpoints require a JWT: call POST /api/v1/users/login, copy the token from the response, then click Authorize above and paste it.

tags.name: Stalls
tags.description: Public browsing of stalls and menus (Kyra)

tags.name: Centres
tags.description: NEA hawker centre open data via data.gov.sg (third-party API)

tags.name: Cuisines
tags.description: Cuisine lookup for menu item categorisation (Wayne)

post.description: Creates a Patron, Vendor, NEAOfficer, Operator or Admin account. The password is hashed with bcrypt before it is stored.

400.description: Missing field, invalid role, or password shorter than 6 characters.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

post.summary: Log in and receive a JWT
post.description: Returns a signed JWT. Send it on protected routes as the header: Authorization: Bearer <token>

400.description: email or password missing.

get.summary: Get the logged-in users own profile

put.summary: Update the logged-in users own profile

400.description: name is required.

get.summary: Get any user by ID (Admin / Operator only)

403.description: Caller is not an Admin or Operator.

delete.summary: Deactivate an account (Admin only, soft delete)
delete.description: Sets IsActive = 0 rather than deleting the row, so past orders and audit history stay intact.

post.summary: Create a payment for an order
post.description: Simulated payment gateway (bank interfaces are handled by another team per the case brief). paymentMethod must be Cash, NETS, PayNow or CreditCard.

400.description: Missing field, or paymentMethod is not one of the allowed values.

409.description: This order has already been paid for.

get.summary: Get the payment status for an order

404.description: No payment found for this order.

put.summary: Update a payment status, e.g. retry a failed payment
put.description: status must be one of Pending, Success, Failed.

400.description: status is not one of the allowed values.

delete.summary: Delete a payment record (Operator / Admin only)
delete.description: Restricted more tightly than the other Payments routes on purpose - reversing a payment is a bigger deal than creating or viewing one. Confirm this matches what the team actually wants before demo night.

post.summary: Admit a new stall into a hawker centre (Operator / Admin only)

400.description: Missing field, or ownerId is not a Vendor.

ownerId.description: must be a UserID with the Vendor role

get.summary: Get a stall and its full menu (public)

200.description: Stall with its menu array returned.

put.summary: Edit a stall's display details (owning Vendor, or Operator/Admin)

403.description: Caller neither owns this stall nor is Operator/Admin.

delete.description: Fails with 409 if the stall still has menu items, orders, promotions, feedback, complaints, inspections or rental agreements pointing at it - clear those first.

409.description: Stall is still referenced by other records.

post.summary: Submit feedback for a stall (Patron only)

400.description: Missing stallId/rating, or rating outside 1-5.

get.summary: Get all feedback for a stall (public)

400.description: Bad Request

403.description: Caller does not own this feedback.
Caller does not own this feedback and is not an Admin.

post.summary: Lodge a complaint against a stall (Patron only)

400.description: Missing field, or description shorter than 10 characters.

description.example: The stall floor was very greasy and unswept.

get.summary: Get the logged-in Patron's own complaint history

put.summary: Update a complaint status (Operator / Admin only)
put.description: status must be one of Open, Investigating, Resolved, Dismissed.

400.description: status is not one of the allowed values.

post.summary: Create a menu item (Vendor only, own stall)

400.description: Missing field, negative price, or invalid category.

403.description: Caller does not own this stall.

get.summary: Get a menu item by ID (public)

put.summary: Update a menu item (Vendor only, own stall)

400.description: Bad Request

403.description: Caller does not own this item.

delete.summary: Delete a menu item (Vendor only, own stall)

403.description: Caller does not own this item.

get.description: Use these CuisineIDs in the cuisineIds array when creating a menu item.

post.summary: Checkout the cart (guest or logged-in Patron)
post.description: If a valid JWT is supplied the order is linked to that Patron; otherwise it is a guest order (patronId is null).

400.description: Missing stallId/items, or an item has an invalid itemId/quantity.

get.summary: Get the logged-in Patron's own order history
get.description: Must be registered above the /:id route below - otherwise Express matches "mine" as an :id value first.

get.summary: Get an order and its line items

put.description: status must be one of Pending, Preparing, Ready, Collected, Cancelled.

400.description: status is not one of the allowed values.

post.summary: Log a hygiene inspection (NEA Officer only)
post.description: Automatically derives and inserts a hygiene grade (A/B/C/D) from the score.

201.description: Inspection recorded and hygiene grade returned.

400.description: Missing field, or score outside 0-100.

remarks.example: Clean workstation, minor grease buildup near sink.

get.summary: Get the inspection and hygiene grade history for a stall (public)
get.description: Public for transparency, so patrons and vendors can see historical hygiene grades.

put.summary: Amend an inspection you recorded (NEA Officer only)

400.description: Bad Request

403.description: Caller did not record this inspection.

delete.summary: Delete an inspection you recorded (NEA Officer only)

403.description: Caller did not record this inspection.

post.summary: Create a promotion (Vendor only, own stall)

400.description: Missing field, discountPercentage outside 1-100, or endDate not after startDate.

403.description: Caller does not own this stall.

get.summary: Get all promotions for a stall (public)

delete.summary: Delete a promotion (Vendor only, own stall)

403.description: Caller does not own this promotion.

put.summary: Edit a promotion (Vendor only, own stall)
put.description: Any field left out keeps its current value.

400.description: discountPercentage outside 1-100, or endDate not after startDate.

403.description: Caller does not own this promotion.

post.summary: Create a rental agreement (Operator / Admin only)
post.description: Stalls can have multiple historical agreements, e.g. from renewals. endDate must not be before startDate.

400.description: Missing field, endDate before startDate, or negative monthlyRent.

get.summary: Get the full rental history for a stall

200.description: Rental agreements returned (may be an empty array).

put.summary: Update a rental agreement (Operator / Admin only)
put.description: Any field left out keeps its current value. status must be Active, Expired or Terminated.

400.description: status is not one of the allowed values.

delete.summary: Delete a rental agreement (Operator / Admin only)

put.summary: Toggle a like on a menu item (Patron only)
put.description: Acts as create-or-delete: if the caller has not liked this item yet it is liked, otherwise the existing like is removed. Returns the new liked state and the updated total count.

200.description: Like toggled; returns liked (boolean) and likeCount.

get.summary: Get the like count for a menu item (public)
Get sales analytics for a stall (Operator / Vendor / Admin only)
get.description: Returns total revenue, total order count, the most popular menu items, and peak ordering hours for the given stall.

200.description: Analytics returned: totalRevenue, totalOrders, popularItems, peakHours.

403.description: Caller is not an Operator, Vendor or Admin.

get.summary: List NEA-registered hawker centres (live from data.gov.sg)
get.description: Proxies the data.gov.sg Datastore Search API from the back-end. Responses are cached in memory for one hour to stay within the upstream rate limit; the cached flag in the response tells you which path was taken.

400.description: Invalid limit, offset or search value.
